text.p: Hurricane Enrique, with 105 mph winds, is about 1050 miles west southwest of the southern tip of Baja in the eastern Pacific, moving west northwest at 17 mph. It is expected to continue this track, moving ou to sea, but remaining quite strong. It is not a threat to major land areas.

Tropical Storm Claudette, with 45 mph winds, is centered about 240 miles south southeast of Cape Hatteras, North Carolina, moving very little. Claudette is expected to drift slowly northward during the next 24 hours, strengthening slightly. It is only a threat to shipping at this time.
There are no further statements at this time.
